blocks.text: Two Turkish award options depart SFO on January 8 and arrive in Bangkok at the same time. The business option leaves earlier; the economy option has a shorter elapsed journey.
Consider this if the reported business cabin and 8:40 a.m. departure suit you. It arrives at the same time as the economy option, with a 7-hour connection in Istanbul.
blocks.label: Turkish business award via LAX

blocks.text: Consider this if economy suits you and a later departure with a shorter journey is preferable: it leaves 3 hours 7 minutes later, arrives at the same time, and has 187 minutes less elapsed time. Its Turkish quote is 110,000 points, versus 275,000 for business; both point quotes have unknown scope.
blocks.label: Turkish economy award via LAX

blocks.text: Both options need a separate SFO–LAX cash flight and an LAX award ticket. The award records do not provide a tax amount or reliable seat-count evidence, and do not establish support for your party. The separate-ticket and positioning arrangements are unverified. The positioning fares are quoted at USD 59 and USD 109, respectively, but their price scope is unknown; these figures and the point quotes therefore do not establish a complete trip cost.
The SFO–BKK cash itinerary was quoted at USD 452.00; its price scope is unknown.
blocks.label: Cash itinerary reference
